## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is bounded and unrelated work is excluded.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; untested cases and existing failures are disclosed.
- [ ] Sessions, ownership, server authority and persistent player data remain protected.
- [ ] Visual obstacles, access/arrival and resource disposal match the implementation.
- [ ] New assets/references have rights, credits and honest capture-date/accuracy notes.
- [ ] Generated outputs are rebuilt from committed inputs; docs/backlog are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, private player data, local databases or raw review artifacts are included.

## Deployment / follow-up

Maintainers handle deployment. List migration/recovery needs and follow-up tasks; do not describe a local-only change as live.
